messages:
Asha (runtime): Postmortem follow-up: we need a compact owner-and-timeline plan for the KV-cache memory surge and OOMs. Focus: immediate blast-radius reduction + actionable telemetry.
Priya: I'll own the blast-radius changes: per-shard soft eviction, per-tenant hard cap, and an emergency reject path. ETA: Fri EOD.
Miguel: I'll add unit + integration tests and a tiny replay harness to reproduce the residency surge. ETA: Wed.
Jin: I'll run targeted profiler runs (cold, warm, sustained 10m) with slab sampling and upload heap profiles to INF-998.
Asha (runtime): Jin, include pprof commands and note GC flags used. Priya, add a config flag so we can A/B the eviction in canary.
Sam (oncall): I'll schedule canary and watch for KV-residency slope and OOM alerts for 48h after deploy. Also lowering the alert threshold to catch earlier drift.
Priya: Rollback trigger: if canary shows >5% client errors or memory drift >20% over 30m, revert immediately and open incident.
Miguel: I'll add a CI gate: after 5m of synthetic load, per-shard residency growth must be <=10%, else fail. Will link CI job to INF-998.
watchdog-bot: Runbook snippet and alert changes appended to ticket INF-998.
Asha (runtime): Check-in Friday 11am PT. I'll update the postmortem with owners/status and mark actions as in-progress. Thanks all. :rocket:
